# Track-cut thresholds, tuned with the Punzi FOM (a=3), reference mass m300, 1e20 POT, 2026-11-13.
# Samples: CORSIKA-overlay HNL m300/m365, BNB 60k with the dk2nu timing fix. Scans: hub_run/thresholds_v2/.
# Generated by examples/hnl_mupi_thresholds.ipynb; open_angle_max changed by hand.
trk_score = 0.5   # trk_quality: track-like: trackScore >
min_len = 15   # trk_quality: good track length > [cm]; FOM300 0.00168 (peak 0.00171), B_n=50458
max_dist_vtx = 80   # trk_quality: good track start-to-vertex distance < [cm]; FOM300 0.00193 (peak 0.00193), B_n=52816
mip_min_len = 5   # mip: MIP track length > [cm]; FOM300 0.00282 (peak 0.00282), B_n=16014
mip_chi2mu_max = 60   # mip: MIP track chi2_mu (per point, plane 2) <; FOM300 0.00281 (peak 0.00283), B_n=18707
mip_chi2p_min = 85   # mip: MIP track chi2_p (per point, plane 2) >; FOM300 0.00281 (peak 0.00281), B_n=18707
shw_score = 0.5   # no_shower: primary shower: 0 < trackScore <
shw_min_energy = 1   # no_shower: primary shower energy > [GeV]; FOM300 0.00281 (peak 0.00281), B_n=18505
open_angle_max = 30   # open_angle: MIP-pair opening angle < [deg]; FOM300 0.00665 (peak 0.00732), B_n=1576; set by hand to 30 (auto pick 20): m365 FOM peaks at 30, m300 loses 8%
contain_margin = 2   # contained: track ends at least this far inside the TPC [cm]; FOM300 0.00382 (peak 0.00382), B_n=200
michel_score = 0.6   # no_michel: Michel-like: 0 < trackScore <; FOM300 0.00453 (peak 0.00453), B_n=32
michel_max_energy = 0.3   # no_michel: Michel-like visible energy < [GeV]; FOM300 0.00453 (peak 0.00456), B_n=32
